# Satyajit Patra — Portfolio

> Portfolio of Satyajit Patra, a B.Tech Computer Science student and software developer working with Java, Python, React, and Machine Learning.

Single-page portfolio site showcasing background, skills, services, projects, and contact information. All content lives in sections of the home page.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Full portfolio — hero introduction, about, skills, services, projects, and contact.

## Sections

- [About](/#about): Background, education, and personal introduction.
- [Skills](/#skills): Technical skills across languages, web development, databases, and tools.
- [Services](/#services): Services offered (web development, AI/ML, etc.).
- [Portfolio](/#portfolio): Selected projects with tech stacks.
- [Contact](/#contact): Email, phone, and links to reach out.
